About the role: Loftware is expanding its worldwide 24x7 Cloud Operations Team and we are looking for a technically motivated Cloud Operations Engineer with a strong cloud-based Linux and Windows knowledge. The Cloud Operations Engineer will be hands-on and involved with building, maintaining, and troubleshooting customer environments for mission-critical application use across the range of cloud platforms used by Loftware, including AWS and Azure. The Cloud Operations Engineer is someone that is a team player with the desire and passion for modern technology and keen to take on large-scale responsibility for the cloud environment. The Cloud Operations Engineer will work with the rest of the Cloud Operations team and alongside QA and Development to continually improve automated infrastructure and application deployment, to build and maintain reliable cloud infrastructure and services and to manage the highly available and scalable solutions that Loftware customers rely on. This is an excellent opportunity to be part of a team helping to evolve our solutions for different cloud platforms as well as expand your skills in the cloud. The base salary range for this position is $115,000 to $160,000 annually. This range represents the good-faith minimum and maximum salary that the organization believes it would pay for this role at the time of this posting (these ranges are dependent on location of hire). Key Roles & Responsibilities - Lead Cloud Operations Excellence - Own and enhance monitoring, observability, and alerting frameworks across AWS, Azure, and other platforms. - Define SLIs/SLOs and drive continuous reliability improvements. - Drive Automation & Infrastructure as Code - Architect and maintain scalable, reusable IaC solutions using Terraform, Terragrunt, and Ansible. - Champion automation-first approaches to eliminate manual operational tasks. - Security & Compliance Leadership - Design and enforce cloud security best practices, governance, and compliance standards. - Lead vulnerability assessments and remediation strategies across environments. - Reliability & Resilience Engineering - Design and implement disaster recovery (DR), backup strategies, and high availability architectures. - Lead incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and postmortem reviews with actionable improvements. - Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner closely with Engineering, QA, and Product teams to improve system architecture and application performance - Influence design decisions to enhance scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency. - Cloud Networking Architecture- Design and manage complex networking setups including VPNs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateways, and hybrid connectivity. - Performance Optimization- Identify bottlenecks and lead initiatives to optimize system performance and cost efficiency. - Mentorship & Leadership - Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team skill development. - Define and promote best practices across cloud operations. - On-Call & Incident Leadership - Participate in and lead on-call rotations. - Act as escalation point for critical incidents and ensure rapid resolution Required Qualifications: - 8+ years of relevant experience in cloud operations, SRE, or infrastructure engineering - Strong expertise in AWS and/or Azure - Deep experience with Linux and/or Windows server environments - Proven experience leading operational initiatives in production environments - Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal) Preferred Technical Experience: - Database: PostgreSQL Microsoft SQL Server - Scripting: Python, Java, Bash, .NET/C#, Powershell - IAC and Automation: Terraform, Terragrunt,Ansible, Rundeck, Jenkins - Cloud networking concepts: VPN, direct connect, transit gateways - Container Technologies: Docker, Kubernetes - Cloud-native technologies: RDS, Microservices, Serverless computing Why Join Us? - Working for the undisputed global leader in a business-critical industry offers unparalleled possibilities. - Our team is made up of the most talented, curious, and inspiring people in their fields, each bringing something unique to the table. - We use the power of the global team. - We set you up for success. We offer comprehensive training to all employees and place an emphasis on employee development. We Win with Inclusion At Loftware, inclusion, diversity, and belonging are paramount to our success and our culture. We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, sex, gender, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. We believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. With over 500 industry experts and 1,000 global partners, Loftware maintains a global presence with offices in the US, UK, Germany, Slovenia, China, and Singapore making us a trusted partner for companies in automotive, chemicals, clinical trials, consumer products, electronics, food & beverage, manufacturing, medical device, pharmaceuticals, retail/apparel, and more. title: Telecom Engineer
description: About Legence Legence (Nasdaq: LGN) is a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. The company specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing complex HVAC, process piping, and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems—enhancing energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in new and existing facilities. Legence also delivers long-term performance through strategic upgrades and holistic solutions. Serving some of the world’s most technically demanding sectors, Legence counts over 60% of the Nasdaq-100 Index among its clients. Telecom Engineer (POTS, Teams Voice, SIP, Cellular) Location: Remote, United States. Near a Legence office location is preferred. Travel: Yes, occasional travel is required. Overview The Telecom Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, operation, and support of the enterprise voice and telecommunications environment. This role ensures reliable, secure, and cost-effective communication services across legacy and modern platforms, including POTS, Microsoft Teams Voice, SIP trunking, and cellular services. Key Responsibilities - Design, implement, and support enterprise voice solutions including Microsoft Teams Voice, Direct Routing, and Operator Connect. - Administer and maintain POTS lines for life-safety systems and regulatory requirements. - Manage SIP trunking services including call routing, failover, and quality optimization. - Support auto attendants, call queues, voicemail, E911, and number management. - Manage cellular services including provisioning, carrier plans, and lifecycle management. - Provide Tier 2/3 support and perform root-cause analysis for telecom issues. - Coordinate with carriers and vendors for service delivery and escalation. - Maintain documentation including call flows, inventories, and runbooks. - Ensure compliance with E911, Kari’s Law, and RAY BAUM’s Act. Required Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. - 5+ years of enterprise telecom or voice engineering experience. - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Teams Voice. - Strong understanding of POTS, SIP, and PSTN connectivity. - Experience working with telecom carriers. - Strong troubleshooting and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications - Experience with Direct Routing SBCs. - Experience with E911 solutions. - Familiarity with legacy PBX systems. - Telecom or Microsoft certifications. Compensation: $106k-$138k, depending on experience. This role is also eligible for an annual performance based bonus. Bonus eligibility and payout are determined by role, individual performance, and company performance, and are not guaranteed. Benefits Overview 401(k) Plan with Company Match: Currently match contributions dollar-for-dollar up to 4% of eligible pay; immediate vesting. Health & Welfare Benefits: Employer provided medical, dental, vision, prescription drug, Employee Assistance Program and accident & illness coverage. Life and Disability Insurance: Employer provided basic life insurance and AD&D valued at 50K coverage amount with the option for voluntary buy up for additional coverage. Time Off: Flexible non-accrual vacation; company holidays per policy. (For California employees, this is separate from California paid sick leave, if applicable.) Expenses: Business travel and related expenses reimbursed per company policy. Reasonable Accommodations If you need assistance or accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at or your dedicated recruiter with the job title and requisition number. Employment Eligibility Candidates must have current work authorization in the U.S.; visa sponsorship is not available for this position. description: Band Level 6Job Description Summary This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the Hiring Manager.Job Description The Strategy, Platforms & Transformation team is dedicated to enabling improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. We work within the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data-driven decision-making. This role is crucial in driving AI transformation by bringing the best in AI and tech to unlock opportunities for growth and improve patient outcomes. The Director, AI Platform Engineer will lead the engineering delivery and evolution of the organization’s AI platform, with responsibility across platform design, development, integration, operations, and continuous improvement. This role will be instrumental in enabling the transformation of existing processes, products, and services into agentic AI products and intelligent workflows by providing the core platform capabilities needed to support scalable, secure, and reliable AI adoption. The ideal candidate brings strong engineering leadership, platform expertise, and technical depth to guide architectural decisions, oversee implementation, and drive operational excellence across shared AI services and tools. Working closely with product leaders, forward deployed engineering teams, data and infrastructure partners, and business stakeholders, this role will ensure the AI platform supports enterprise priorities, accelerates solution delivery, and evolves in line with user needs, performance insights, and emerging technologies. Major Accountabilities - Lead the design, development, integration, deployment, and ongoing support of the organization's AI platform and related engineering capabilities. - Define and implement platform architecture, engineering standards, and development practices that promote scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability. - Partner with product, data, infrastructure, security, and business teams to align platform capabilities with enterprise needs and strategic priorities. - Oversee engineering teams in building reusable platform services, tools, and components that enable agentic AI products and workflows. - Drive modernization and integration efforts to connect existing systems and processes with AI platform capabilities. - Monitor platform performance, operational health, and user feedback to identify improvements, resolve issues, and support continuous optimization. - Establish effective operating models, support processes, and governance practices to ensure consistent delivery and platform reliability. - Communicate platform priorities, delivery progress, technical risks, and investment needs to senior leaders and cross functional stakeholders. Essential Requirements: - Bachelor degree required and advanced degree preferred, ideally in business, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field. - 8 plus years of AI engineering experience, with a strong track record of leading product strategy, roadmap development, and delivery for complex digital, data, or AI enabled products. - Demonstrated experience in AI and data driven product environments, including translating business needs into scalable product solutions and partnering closely with technical teams to bring innovative products to market. - Strong cross functional leadership skills, with proven ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Innovation, Design, Data Science, Commercial, and other business teams to drive alignment and execution. - Experience managing and developing product managers or junior product leaders, including coaching, prioritization support, and fostering strong product management practices. - Excellent strategic, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to evaluate opportunities, make informed tradeoffs, and clearly communicate product vision, priorities, and outcomes to stakeholders. Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards. US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves. title: Engineering Manager Embedded
description: Our mission at Qwello is to revolutionize the charging industry, we are committed to turn the world from combustion to electric. We put the customer first. We know their needs and deliver results they love. We design, build and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus and engineering excellence. We value diversity of thought, background and approaches and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars. Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future! We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Embedded team - the team that designs, builds and ships Qwello's AC charging stations, from circuit board to firmware to the production line. This is not a pure software management role. Your team of 6-8 spans embedded software, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering, and your scope runs from the firmware release train for thousands of chargers in the field, through EMC labs and Eichrecht certification audits, to the contract manufacturer's factory floor. Our firmware is built on embedded Linux (Yocto) and EVerest, the open source EV charging stack we actively contribute to upstream. We are working with Rust, Python, C & C++. You will not be the deepest specialist in any one of these - your tech leads are - but you must be technical enough to represent the team when they are not in the room, to challenge estimates, and to make trade-offs between firmware, hardware and regulatory constraints with confidence and competence. If you have led embedded or hardware-adjacent teams, enjoy being the person to which a factory, a certification body and a firmware engineer all escalate in the same week, and who brings the self-organization to keep all of it moving without dropping balls, we would love to talk. Please Note: Tell us about a physical product you helped ship - what your team built, what went wrong on the way to production, and what your part in fixing it was. Your Responsibilities 🚀 Lead and grow a team of 6-8 engineers across embedded software, electrical and mechanical engineering: 1:1s, performance reviews, compensation input, hiring and, when needed, structured performance management Own delivery: quarterly planning and OKRs with leadership, translating requests from our country organizations into scoped, estimated engineering work, and saying no with a rationale when needed Own the firmware release train (dev, canary, production) for the charger fleet and be answerable for fleet-impacting incidents alongside our operations teams Drive certification and compliance as a permanent workstream: Eichrecht (Modul B and Modul D), CE and EMC campaigns, VDE and TÜV interactions, DSO assessments and upcoming regulation and technologies like vehicle-to-grid (V2G), changes to the AFIR and such Manage key vendors and partners across the full bill of materials: our EVCC board supplier, meter vendors, payment terminal providers, the contract manufacturer running our production line, and our open source partners upstream Keep production shippable: end-of-line testing, BOM changes and cost analysis, supply chain risk, and same-day escalation support when the factory line stops Build a resilient team structure: develop tech leads, keep yourself off the critical path of IC work, and reduce bus factor on certification and hardware knowledge Your Profile ✨ Several years of experience managing embedded, firmware or hardware-adjacent engineering teams, including hiring, performance reviews and difficult personnel conversations A solid engineering background in embedded systems: you have shipped firmware or devices to production and can hold a technical argument with strong, opinionated senior engineers Comfort with the physical side of the product: electronics, EMC, test labs, manufacturing. You do not need to design circuits, but this world must not be foreign to you Demonstrated experience working with certification bodies, notified bodies or regulated products - or the appetite and rigor to own this quickly Outstanding self-organization: this role has many parallel threads (people, releases, audits, vendors, factory), and following through reliably is the single most important skill A track record of building self-managing teams: delegating, developing tech leads and staying off the critical path rather than being the hero Excellent communication skills in English, from firmware engineers to executives to external auditors Nice to have German language skills - a significant part of our supplier, certification and authority communication runs in German Experience in EV charging or e-mobility: OCPP, ISO 15118, Eichrecht, smart charging Familiarity with embedded Linux (Yocto), EVerest or other open source involvement, Rust or modern C++ Experience working with contract manufacturers and owning production or end-of-line testing Experience managing multi-generation products (legacy fleet plus new platform in parallel) Your Benefits 🪴 Flat hierarchies with efficient decision-making processes without red tape The opportunity to play a key role in shaping the mobility revolution Work on products that have a direct impact on the future of sustainable transportation Be part of an international and dynamic team of more than 30 nationalities Enjoy a flexible hybrid setup — choose how you want to split your time between our Munich office and working from home, with the possibility of workation within the EU, plus 30 vacation days Regular company and team events outside of the office to disconnect from our computers and reconnect with colleagues on hikes, mountain e-bike tours, offsites and more Personal and professional development through in-house Lunch & Learn sessions, collaborative knowledge sharing, as well as externally provided training, courses and conferences Discounted access to Wellpass for comprehensive wellbeing support - title: Senior Implementation Specialist Digital Analytics (w/m/d)
description: Your new team: As an Implementation Specialist, you are right at the heart of our projects: You translate business requirements into robust technical tracking solutions, implement them, ensure their quality, and turn concepts into fully functioning digital analytics setups. You develop and document tracking concepts, data models, and data layer requirements and align them with clients and developers. You work with tag management systems, implement tracking and third-party tags, and ensure scalable data collection. You conduct technical testing, debugging, and data validation and systematically investigate data quality issues. You work closely with Digital Analysts, Data Engineers, and Project Managers, acting as the technical interface between business and development. We deliberately work independently of specific tools while bringing many years of expertise and strong partnerships with, among others, Google and Adobe. Our projects range from auditing and optimizing existing implementations to complete new implementations and migrations, as well as complex analytics and data setups. You also won’t work in isolation: At FELD M, the close connection between business, analytics, and technology is at the core of what we do. This intersection is what makes the role particularly exciting. What else? We believe in People First and Sustainable Pace. Taking responsibility and delivering high-quality work does not mean constantly operating at full speed. We want to do great work sustainably – together, with mutual support and room for different lifestyles.We are looking for people who are curious, take ownership, and enjoy sharing their expertise. Working knowledge of ISO 22716 (Cosmetics GMP) and cosmetic microbiological testing and challenge testing (e.g. ISO 11930) principles. Practical experience with root cause analysis and CAPA processes. Comfortable reviewing batch records, certificates of analysis, and laboratory test reports independently. Experience working with external testing laboratories and coordinating results against acceptance criteria. title: Sr. Backend Engineer
description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond. We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover Seven European markets live 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai $40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will be a technical anchor across the team — expected to lead by example, shape architecture decisions, and raise the quality bar for everything we ship. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying deeply embedded in collaborative engineering culture. Tech Stack: Java 21 (Spring Boot 3), Python, LangGraph, LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js, React. What you will do Take ownership of complex backend systems from design through production — including architecture, implementation, and long-term maintenance. Lead technical discussions, drive engineering decisions, and document trade-offs clearly for the team. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and structured feedback. Identify systemic weaknesses in our infrastructure, propose improvements, and execute on them with minimal direction. Collaborate across engineering, product, and data to align technical direction with business goals. Drive improvements to observability, reliability, and performance across our backend stack. Contribute to hiring by participating in technical interviews and helping define the engineering bar. Who you are 7+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of owning critical systems in production. Deep expertise in Java (Spring Boot) and strong familiarity with Python; comfortable navigating a polyglot codebase. Viele Möglichkeiten, als Team zu sozialisieren - virtuell und persönlich, wenn möglich. Natürlich kostenlose Steuererklärung durch die Taxfix-App – und interne Unterstützung bei allen persönlichen steuerbezogenen Fragen. Ein großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget zur Unterstützung Deiner persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung sowie Beratung durch unsere internen L&D-Experten. Das bewirkst du bei uns: Du wirkst im Tagesgeschäft und in Projekten rund um Innovation & New Business in der Versicherungswirtschaft mit. Du recherchierst und analysierst aktuelle Trends, Technologien, Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Marktentwicklungen und bereitest relevante Impulse für unsere Projekte und Formate auf. Du bringst dich kreativ in die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung neuer Ideen und Formate ein – von der ersten Konzeption bis zur konkreten Umsetzung. Du arbeitest an unserem Trendradar mit, recherchierst und bewertest neue Entwicklungen, bereitest Inhalte auf, führst Plausibilitätschecks durch und erstellst begleitende Unterlagen. Du bereitest Erkenntnisse, Trends und Impulse zielgruppengerecht auf und hilfst uns dabei, auch komplexe Themen verständlich und ansprechend für unterschiedliche Kommunikations- und Austauschformate zu vermitteln. Darum passt du zu uns: Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, hast noch mindestens zwei Semester vor dir und verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Du interessierst dich für Innovation, neue Technologien, Trends und Geschäftsmodelle und hast Lust, dich mit neuen Themen auseinanderzusetzen. title: Senior Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Every mind is unique. Yet much of the world is still built for what’s considered "normal," leaving too many people behind. At Everway, we change that by creating technology that helps everyone understand and be understood. By understanding and addressing the unique needs of each individual, we're creating a world where differences are recognized and valued.</p> <p>Our careers fit real life. When you join us, you’re not just taking a job. You’re joining a movement to build a more neuroinclusive world. We’re a global community of over 800 employees spanning North America, UK, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. A career here is purposeful and fast-moving, with clear expectations, modern tools, and the clarity to focus on what matters most.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our people are supported and encouraged to show up as they are, with different ways of thinking welcomed and valued. We pride ourselves on our core values that are embedded within our culture. These are to <strong>be curious, have courage, and commit fully</strong>.</p> <p>Join us at Everway - together, we can unlock the full potential of every mind.</p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape how technology empowers neurodivergent individuals and people with physical, sensory and other disabilities.</p> <p>You'll work across Everway's portfolio of special education and assistive technology solutions for school and workplace environments, collaborating closely with Product Management, Engineering, Research, Content and other cross-functional partners.</p> <p>A key focus of this role will be our IEP product portfolio, including Polaris, Embrace Education and Spedtrack. You'll work across interconnected products and experiences, helping create coherent, accessible and scalable solutions that support the needs of educators, administrators and students.</p> <p>This role offers the opportunity to think beyond individual features and products. You'll help shape shared experiences and interaction patterns across the portfolio, balancing consistency with the unique context and needs of individual products and users.</p> <p>You'll lead end-to-end design work, from understanding complex problems and synthesising research through ideation, prototyping, validation and delivery. You'll contribute to product strategy, design quality and our design system, while exploring practical applications of AI and emerging technologies.</p> <p>You'll also work closely with other designers, providing senior design partnership, sharing knowledge and helping raise design quality across the portfolio.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to have a significant influence on the future of Everway's IEP experiences and help create accessible, coherent and high-quality products that make a meaningful difference to the people who use them.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h4><strong>Main responsibilities</strong></h4> <p>In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Research, Content and Marketing to deliver product experiences that meet user and business needs.</li> <li>Own end-to-end design work within your scope, contributing design expertise to product decisions from early discovery through delivery and iteration.</li> <li>Help frame problems, identify opportunities and contribute design insight to product strategy and planning.</li> <li>Design across interconnected products, workflows and user journeys to create scalable and coherent experiences.</li> <li>Translate user insights, product analytics and business objectives into intuitive, accessible and scalable design solutions.</li> <li>Work closely with Engineering to understand technical constraints and opportunities, ensuring solutions are practical, scalable and effectively implemented.</li> <li>Contribute to and evolve Everway's design system, supporting consistency, scalability and accessibility across products.</li> <li>Explore and apply AI where it creates meaningful value, improving design workflows, accelerating prototyping and supporting new product experiences, while considering usability, accessibility, trust, transparency and user control.</li> <li>Create and present design concepts, prototypes and solutions with clear rationale linked to user, product and business objectives.</li> <li>Advocate for inclusive design and ensure work meets or exceeds relevant accessibility standards.</li> <li>Partner with researchers to integrate user insights into iterative design and validation cycles.</li> <li>Balance qualitative user insights with quantitative product analytics to inform design decisions and measure the success of shipped experiences.</li> <li>Facilitate workshops, design reviews and co-creation sessions with peers and stakeholders.</li> <li>Share knowledge and contribute to design practice, learning and innovation across the UX and Product organisation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Essential criteria</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Significant product design experience, including 3+ years operating at Senior Product Designer level, with a strong portfolio demonstrating how design decisions contributed to measurable user, product or business outcomes.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work with ambiguity, frame complex problems and influence product direction.</li> <li>Experience applying inclusive and universal design principles, reducing cognitive load, and designing to recognised accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2</li> <li>Experience designing across interconnected products, complex workflows or end-to-end user journeys while considering the wider product ecosystem.</li> <li>Hands-on experience contributing to and evolving design systems.</li> <li>Strong prototyping and interaction design skills, with the ability to use prototypes to explore, test and communicate ideas.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern design tools such as Figma.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-enhanced design workflows and an understanding of emerging human-AI interaction patterns, including trust, transparency, uncertainty and user control.</li> <li>Ability to communicate and influence design decisions clearly across a range of stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong collaboration with Product Management and Engineering, balancing user needs, business goals and technical constraints.</li> <li>Understanding of modern product development approaches such as Agile, Lean UX, continuous discovery and iterative delivery, with experience facilitating collaborative design activities.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable criteria</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience designing across Web, iOS and Android in a complex SaaS environment.</li> <li>Experience designing products for education, accessibility, assistive technology or other complex user needs.</li> <li>Experience designing or shipping AI-enabled product experiences.</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted prototyping or design-to-development workflows.</li> <li>Experience working with product analytics and experimentation to evaluate product outcomes.</li> <li>Familiarity with designing for enterprise, education or multi-user environments with complex permissions, roles or workflows.</li> </ul> <p>Please submit your application by <strong>Friday 18th September 2026.</strong></p> <p>Please note: applications may close early due to high demand, so early submission is encouraged.</p> <p>#everway</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Join our team and enjoy a competitive salary with bonus opportunities, flexible work schedules, and comprehensive health and wellness benefits. We offer flexible time off plans, career growth through development programs, and a collaborative, innovative culture where your ideas matter.&nbsp; Ready to make an impact? Apply today and be part of a company that invests in your success!</p> <p>We are committed to providing a Drug-Free Workplace for all employees.</p> <p>We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.</p> <p>You can view our Recruitment and Selection Policy <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yDxHyVbhh8MK9NnCYdnEAfVSO4rhPCovVbKK8ecxT4U/edit?usp=sharing">here.</a></p> <p>Please click the link for our <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1uAKvHVSRsqZ83CGhM3_3Dc6RPsXwlTdmwdUH7msHkVM/edit?usp=sharing">Privacy Notice</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Manager, Enterprise
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. About the team The Enterprise Business team at Airwallex helps ambitious businesses operate globally by providing the financial infrastructure they need to manage payments, money movement and related financial operations. The Account Management team works strategically to maximise the enterprise customer-Airwallex partnership by building trust, identifying and driving new revenue streams, and ensuring operational success.. You will work alongside , Leadership, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations,Legal, GTM Partnerships, Customer Success, Finance and Revenue Strategy & Operations. The team operates with a high level of ownership and collaboration, managing complex customer needs and contributing directly to enterprise growth. What you’ll do As an Account Manager on the Enterprise team, you will manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers and help them maximise Airwallex value. You will build trusted relationships across commercial, finance, operations, product and technology stakeholders, while identifying opportunities to increase adoption, retain customers and expand their use of Airwallex’s products and markets. You will combine strategic account planning with hands-on ownership of upsells, , escalations, onboarding and complex customer initiatives. Working cross-functionally, you will turn customer insights into action and contribute to the growth of Airwallex’s Enterprise Business. This role is a quota-carrying commercial role and is based in London, UK. Responsibilities: Grow gross profit from existing customer accounts, manage customer operational success, and pursue upsell and expansion opportunities across Airwallex’s product suite. Build and execute strategic account plans, including customer objectives, stakeholder maps, risks, renewal plans and 12 to 18-month growth opportunities. Lead renewals, commercial negotiations, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, using data and customer insight to improve retention and drive Net Revenue Retention. Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and run effective business reviews that demonstrate value, address risks and align on future priorities. Coordinate complex customer initiatives across Sales, Product Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, KYC and Onboarding, Legal, Customer Success and other internal teams. Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity tracking and forecasts, while sharing customer feedback that can inform product, operational and go-to-market improvements. Who you are We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Minimum qualifications: 5 to 6 years of sales or account management experience, including experience managing complex enterprise or strategic customer relationships. A proven track record of retaining and growing existing accounts through renewals, upsell, cross-sell or other expansion motions. Experience managing multi-stakeholder customer relationships, including engagement with senior commercial, finance, operations, product or technology leaders. Strong commercial, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build trusted relationships internally and externally. Experience working cross-functionally to resolve customer issues, manage escalations and deliver complex onboarding, implementation or post-go-live initiatives. Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, B2B SaaS or another technology environment with complex products. Experience with API-enabled products is an advantage. Preferred qualifications: Experience managing enterprise accounts in payments, FX, cross-border payments, treasury, cards, embedded finance or other financial infrastructure products. Experience developing strategic account plans, leading QBRs or executive business reviews, and building relationships with C-level stakeholders. A data-driven approach to account health, forecasting, renewal planning and commercial prioritisation, with strong CRM discipline. Curiosity, resilience and an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing environment, adapt to evolving priorities and proactively solve complex customer problems. Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What does the team work on?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">Roku's Automation support and Tools team focuses on providing innovative, impactful tools and SW solutions including AI enabled engineering capabilities to help accelerate validation efforts, improve efficiency, enhance productivity of all engineering team across Roku's entire embedded SW org. The team works across full-stack applications, backend services, and scalable platform services to improve developer productivity, end-to-end testing experience of Roku products and services. You will be joining a talented, high-performance team of developers with a strong delivery culture. We are looking for someone who can help us keep up this pace and continue delivering high quality as we grow.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What is the role?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">Roku is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Embedded Software Automation and Tools team to build full stack applications and services that support end-to-end automation and test infrastructure. This role involves designing and delivering full stack solutions that support cross-functional internal and external stakeholders across the Roku ecosystem. title: Senior Accountant - IFRS
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Senior Accountant / Financial Reporting specialist to join our Finance Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. If you're excited about leveraging AI and automation to redefine modern accounting with a strong focus on IFRS excellence and financial rigor, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Accounting Associate Director and work closely with teams across the Finance organisation. You will be part of a team dedicated to technical rigor and operational efficiency, partnering with cross-functional departments to elevate our accounting processes to the next level. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Accountant, you will: Prepare and post journal entries, perform balance sheet reconciliations, and drive high standards for period close improving quality and speed. Own the preparation of audit schedules, coordinate responses to requests, and drive the closure of audit questions to ensure a predictable, well-documented process. Deep dive into monthly results, flagging risks, unusual transactions, and key movements while providing decision-ready insights for finance leadership. Identify accounting risks, implement practical mitigations, and strengthen internal controls to ensure our processes are scalable and accurate. Actively leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and consistency, identifying opportunities to standardise and simplify recurring accounting work. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 6+ years of experience with a strong ability to apply IFRS in real-world scenarios. Comfort working with consolidated results, analysing variances, and exercising complex accounting estimates and judgments. Proven experience managing audits end-to-end or acting as the primary finance contact for external auditors. A track record (or clear potential) of using AI and automation to improve accounting outcomes and efficiency. The ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with an "ownership mindset" and excellent judgment. Strong ability to translate complex accounting issues into scalable process improvements and clear insights for stakeholders. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You want genuine agency at group level rather than executing instructions handed down by a central team You'd rather design a process than inherit one, and you want to see your own work implemented You like variety. This is a different topic most days, not a fixed monthly cycle This role is not a good fit for you if: You want a settled, mature environment where the process is set and the day looks the same. That's the clearest reason this role doesn't work out for people You need stable priorities. It's volatile here. Several topics run at once, progress depends on other people, and priorities can change overnight You want to stay inside accounting. A large part of the job is working with teams outside Finance and with external advisors in each country How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 - 12 months at Pleo, you’ll: Lead the Audit Readiness initiative to drive impact in our year-end execution and documentation standards. Collaborate with the Finance team to embed AI-forward ways of working, automating manual workflows to increase team capacity. Grow your skills in process improvements and financial analysis, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale across our legal entity markets. We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger leadership projects, mastering the intersection of AI and Finance, or deepening your expertise in complex consolidated reporting. The location This role is hybrid (on average, 3 days a week in the office) and can be located in either our Lisbon or Madrid office. Show me the benefits! 💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) 🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office 🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays 🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options 🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice ❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far 👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring manager interview: A conversation with our Accounting Associate Director covering your technical accounting and IFRS experience. Team panel and Pleo challenge: You'll meet the hiring manager, his manager and a peer from the team. The challenge is presented live in the session, so there's nothing to prepare or send in advance. We're looking at how you handle complexity, new areas and stakeholders. Final interview: A closing conversation, used where it's helpful for both sides. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired this role, we received a lot of applications but can only interview a finite number of people. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Supply Planner
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>Anduril is seeking a Senior Supply Planner to join our team in Sydney, Australia. The Supply Chain team is responsible for planning and sourcing of materials to support rapidly iterating and building of cutting-edge defense hardware for autonomous underwater vehicles (AUV). You will have responsibility spanning the entire value chain from raw materials through finished goods and contributing to the strategic supply network development of Anduril’s product hardware, across their life cycles. You will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build.</p> <h3>WHAT YOU'LL DO:</h3> <ul> <li>Partner with design and manufacturing engineers to accelerate product development via activities such as:</li> <ul> <li>build bottom-up cost models, using supplier data and manufacturing insight to benchmark pricing and identify cost drivers</li> <li>rapidly align on build requirements, constraints, and feasibility against schedule</li> <li>Perform impact assessment on build schedule when change reviews are proposed and implemented</li> </ul> <li>Own and maintain the line of balance (LOB) for assigned programs, ensuring material availability is synchronised to the master build schedule. You'll be the connective tissue between procurement, production, and engineering — translating build requirements into actionable supply plans and driving resolution when gaps threaten schedule</li> <li>Drive and support clear-to-build (CTB) reviews ahead of each build phase, confirming all materials, long-lead items, and supplier deliverables are on hand or on track</li> <li>Collaborate with procurement to expedite, re-sequence, or source alternatives when supply risks emerge, escalating early with data-backed recommendations</li> <li>Track and report schedule adherence metrics (OTD, CTB pass rate, LOB health) and drive root cause analysis on misses.</li> <li>Maintain MRP/ERP system accuracy — planned orders, lead times, safety stock parameters, and demand signals aligned to current program baselines.</li> <li>Support all cost engineering activities to converge the bottoms-up cost curve to product cost, maximizing the total cost of ownership (TCO) across the product lifecycle</li> <li>Support new product introduction (NPI) builds by developing initial supply plans from early-stage BOMs and engineering change orders.</li> </ul> <h3>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:</h3> <ul> <li>Ideally has background within:</li> <ul> <li>7+ years in supply planning, production planning, or materials management within a complex hardware manufacturing environment, preferably defence or aerospace.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience managing line of balance and clear-to-build processes across multi-level BOMs with long-lead and constrained materials.</li> <li>Track record of maintaining build schedule adherence in a rate production or NPI environment.Design &amp; development of electronics and/or mechanical devices</li> <li>Advanced supply planning experience, including stints in production planning, materials management, or master scheduling roles</li> </ul> <li>Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment</li> <li>Prior knowledge of Oracle or a similar Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3><strong>Group&nbsp;Overview</strong></h3> <p>Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&amp;C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts. Metrea specialises in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.</p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The Expeditionary Operations Lab, or EXOLAB, focuses on the rapid development, integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">evaluation</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and delivery of expeditionary capabilities within the Electromagnetic Warfare and Cyber domain.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">EXOLAB works across research and development, experimentation, prototyping, systems integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">trials</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and operational delivery. The team addresses complex customer problems by combining existing technologies, emerging </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">capabilities</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and internally developed solutions into deployable systems.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The lab </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">operates</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> across airborne, land, maritime and dismounted environments, with a strong emphasis on practical engineering, rapid learning and delivering systems that are operationally relevant, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">supportable</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and resilient.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW239653401 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking a Principal RF Engineer to lead and support the research, design, development, integration and delivery of radio-frequency systems for expeditionary Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum operations and secure communications capabilities.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will be responsible for the RF engineering aspects of prototype and operational systems, including RF architecture, receiver and transmitter chains, antenna systems, signal distribution, filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, interference management and system performance analysis.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Principal RF Engineer will operate as a senior technical authority within a multidisciplinary team comprising electrical, systems, mechanical, software, cyber and operational specialists. The role will support the full engineering lifecycle, from concept development and technology evaluation through detailed design, integration, verification, trials, deployment and through-life support.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a practical, delivery-focused engineering role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between theoretical analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, prototype development, platform integration and field trials.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will be based either in Lincoln or London, with a longer-term intent to transition the primary location to London if hired initially in Lincoln.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description: Who are we? Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting Smarkets is a prediction market exchange for sports and political trading, having handled over $50 billion in volume since 2010. We're upending sports betting with the fairest prices, the best technology, and a superior customer experience, powered by attracting great people and building a high-performance environment where they thrive. We're looking for an atypical candidate with strong regulated-business experience to support our growing CFTC business. The Team Security sits within Infrastructure and Engineering, protecting the distributed, real-time systems behind our trading engine. The team's remit spans our core products and our DCM/DCO entities, with a real regulatory dimension to the work, particularly around our CFTC-regulated business units. Alongside that regulatory scope, the focus is squarely on hands-on engineering: designing, building, and shipping the security tooling and controls that let engineering teams move fast safely. About the Role: This is a founding build. You'll stand up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and mature it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams to build the controls, automation, and guardrails our trading systems and regulated entities need. What you will do: Build the Foundations: Be part of a founding build, standing up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and maturing it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams. Design Guardrails: Design, build, and deploy security controls and guardrails across cloud-native platforms, including AI security solutions protecting customer-facing and internal products. Automate as Code: Automate security processes as code, embedding compliance and infrastructure-as-code checks into CI/CD pipelines without slowing down frequent shipping. Assess & Remediate: Conduct risk audits and assessments, translating findings into practical recommendations for engineering teams, and be hands-on in implementing those recommendations. Monitor & Respond: Monitor and analyse system access logs, flag anomalies, and support incident response, containment, and post-incident root cause analysis. Plan for Resilience: Plan and test security backups and disaster recovery processes to keep the platform resilient. Maintain Compliance: Develop and maintain security policies, standards, and controls meeting DCM/DCO requirements, and maintain evidence and documentation to support regulatory examinations and audits. Partner Across Teams: Partner with business and engineering teams on solutions, translating technical work for product and engineering audiences. Champion Ownership: Build a culture of security ownership among engineers, acting as a security partner rather than a gatekeeper. Role Requirements: Security Engineering Background: Hands-on experience building security engineering/DevSecOps capabilities in a cloud-native, high-growth environment, ideally financial services or exchange infrastructure. Confident Communicator: Comfortable communicating security risk, controls and technical decisions verbally and in writing to external stakeholders such as auditors or regulators. Regulatory Familiarity: Familiarity with CFTC system safeguards expectations, including 17 C.F.R. § 38.1051 and § 39.18 or similar regulatory requirements. AppSec Foundations: Strong grasp of application security principles (OWASP Top 10, NIST) and secure SDLC practices. CI/CD & Tooling: Proficiency with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI) and security tools (Snyk, Aqua, Trivy, Checkov, Twistlock, Clair). Cloud & Container Security: Hands-on expertise securing AWS/Azure/GCP, Kubernetes, containers, and IaC. Compliance as Code: Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code and compliance-as-code practices. Automation Proficiency: Proficiency in at least one of Python, Bash, or Go, with a track record of automating security processes. Nice-to-have: Demonstrated experience deploying AI security solutions, guardrails, and defences for AI systems used by customers; a personal interest in sports, exchanges, or trading; certifications such as DSOP, CKS, CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, or an AWS/Azure/GCP Security Specialty; a track record of security automation at scale in Agile/Scrum environments; direct experience with regulators/examiners on technology and system safeguards; and familiarity with event contracts, prediction markets, or similar novel futures products under CFTC. Our Values Our values are at the heart of everything we do, guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. They reflect what we expect of ourselves and each other to deliver the best results, while fostering a positive, high-performing environment: Push to Win: We set ambitious goals and relentlessly pursue them, always striving for excellence. Make Others Better: We lift each other up, share knowledge, and celebrate team success over individual achievement. Give a Shit: We care deeply about our work, our users, and the impact we make. Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard. Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us. Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn't you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment. Perks & Benefits We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious, united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win. title: Courses and Memberships Sales Associate
description: The Company When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all. With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of certifications, memberships, and learning products, we help individuals and teams grow faster in their careers. We work with some of the world’s most recognisable companies and pride ourselves on being a high-impact learning partner , not just another events business. We’re ambitious, we move quickly, and we’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, a steep learning curve, and plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next. About the Role We’re hiring Sales Associates to join our Education & Membership Sales team , people with energy, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in commercial roles. Your primary focus will be selling our professionals certifications, memberships, and online learning solutions in global markets. You will manage the end-to-end cycle while getting comfortable with engaging senior decision-makers at leading tech companies. Over time, this role can progress into more senior sales or specialist commercial paths across the business. This role is not about arriving fully formed, it’s about building and proving confidence, capability, and momentum through doing. What You'll Be Doing Sales Core: Focused on prospecting, leads qualification, pipeline management, and deal closing. Be able to hold your ground with senior B2B stakeholders and work to clear targets and expectations. Engaging Decision-Makers: Speak directly with professionals at fast-growing and enterprise tech companies, understand their challenges, and recommend the right core certifications and different tiered memberships. Owning Deals End-to-End: Own the pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week. Product Mastery: Develop strong knowledge of our core certifications, different tiered memberships, and broader education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling. Collaboration & Feedback: Work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support. This Role Is For You If Seeking a role to work hard and build a strong career in professional sales. Having a background or a strong interest in education sales, training products, or learning solutions. Comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new and navigating unfamiliar software or sales scripts. Open to actively seeking out feedback and applying it quickly to daily workflow. Taking complete ownership for outcomes, not just daily effort or hours put in. Resilient, organised, and fully able to manage high pace and volume pressure. Communicating clearly with customers and with teammates alike. Enjoying working as part of a high-energy team where success is shared. Base Salary : £26,500 - £28,000 (range depending on experience) Year 1 OTE: Estimated £35,000 (uncapped) Year 2 OTE: Estimated £55,000 (uncapped) Location: this role can be hybrid in our London office or fully remote within the UK (Not abroad). ____________________________ Benefits Time off & flexibility 34 days’ paid holiday including UK Bank holidays and a day off on your birthday. Flexible working hours: our core hours are 10am–4:30pm, with the flexibility to structure your working day between 8am and 8pm around when you work best. Work from where works for you: choose to work remotely within the UK or hybrid from our London office. Our office is always open to the wider team whenever you fancy coming in. WFH Kit: a comprehensive tech setup, plus a dedicated WFH equipment budget. A well-stocked office: snacks, drinks and fresh fruit available in our London office. Health & wellbeing Private Medical and Dental Insurance with Bupa. Life Insurance: cover worth 4x your annual salary. On-demand therapy & coaching: company sponsored access to therapy and career coaching through Spill. Wellness perks: discounts on gym memberships, fitness and wellness classes. Cycle to Work & Workplace Nursery schemes. Perks at Work: access to a wide range of corporate discounts. Monthly flexible benefits allowance through ThanksBen (£50/month in year one, £100/month in year two and £165/month from year three), giving you extra flexibility to spend on the benefits that matter most to you. Learning & development A growing personal L&D budget (starting at £500 per year and increasing with tenure to £3,000 per year). Dedicated L&D or volunteering time: one paid day every quarter to invest in your development or support a cause you care about. Unlimited access to our internal Academy: including courses, learning resources and professional certifications.
